summary: América Móvil filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing that a Brazilian subsidiary, Claro Brasil, closed the acquisition of 72.83% of Desktop S.A.'s capital stock, a Brazilian telecom/ISP target. The filing confirms completion rather than announcement, with no price per share, total consideration, premium, or financing structure stated; further terms were provided in a separate Claro Brasil press release on its relevant-fact notice. The FPI disclosure maps to a US current report on Form 8-K. Watch for minority-holder tag-along dynamics, antitrust follow-up, and eventual control consolidation of the remaining 27.17%.
